name: AXM Diagnostics & Operations Center
actions: inspect an isolated Workshop health snapshot
see which diagnostic probes are degraded or unavailable
review a fixed catalog of bounded redacted log sources
preview a reviewed Windows offline gate packet without writing
record a reviewed Windows offline gate result without retaining raw evidence
export a diagnostic report with persistent digest lineage
summary: Observe Workshop health through independently contained probes, truthful partial coverage, bounded redacted logs, persistent export lineage, and a proof-bounded Windows offline-first evidence gate.
notes: Diagnostics remains observational. The Windows collector is read-only and its point-in-time snapshot cannot prove lifecycle network silence. The gate never disables adapters, installs runtimes, grants public support, publishes, or promotes. Raw gate evidence is not retained when a reviewed result is recorded.
